messages:
Ravi: Starting handoff thread for the night. Primary is @ravi, secondary is @liz until 02:00 UTC, then we have a gap. Quick perms check before bridge.

Liz: got it. what gap?

Ravi: there's no APAC overlap from 02:00-04:00 UTC. we should confirm PD escalation & AWS/Grafana access.

Ash: i can take secondary starting 03:00 UTC if needed, but need PD admin role confirmed.

Ravi: thanks. first checklist: PagerDuty. make sure you can see the Oncall schedule and can escalate. run `pd whoami` or open https://redwood.pagerduty.com/schedules. if PD CLI, example:
```bash
pd login --token $PD_TOKEN
pd schedule-instance list --schedule U12345
```
If you see "You do not have permission" ping security.

Liz: i can run that now. i get schedule view fine but i don't have the ability to run manual escalations (no Admin role). cannot trigger manual page.

Ravi: ok that's important. Manual escalation role required for failover. Ash, can you confirm your PD role?

Ash: i have "Responders" role only. i can acknowledge and resolve incidents but not escalate.

Ravi: Noted. Two options: 1) short-term: add Sam as PD admin for tonight (need approval), 2) create an automatic escalation policy that covers gaps (we already have secondary fallback policy but it relies on APAC oncall).

Sam: i can be temp PD admin for the window. liz, ash — i'll need confirmation that ok to escalate on your behalf.

Liz: fine with that.

Ravi: second checklist: AWS console & assume-role. oncall needs to be able to assume the "redwood-oncall" role in prod account for logs and instance checks. verify with:
```bash
aws sts get-caller-identity
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name oncall-check
```
You should get temp creds and be able to `aws logs filter-log-events` in /prod. if you hit AccessDenied, request a one-time elevation via infra-requests.

Ash: i tried assume-role, got AccessDenied. raised infra-requests ticket #IR-2047. ticket link: https://redwood-internal/infra-requests/IR-2047

Ravi: ok keep that ticket visible. meanwhile Sam if you have access please step in for any AWS checks.

Sam: i can assume role, tested `aws logs` and `kubectl get pods -n prod`. note: to access EKS pods we still need kubeconfig in SSM. i have it.

Ravi: third checklist: Grafana dashboards & alert access. verify you can open the high-sev dashboards and view alert rules: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/ops/production-alerts. also confirm you can mute/unmute alerts from the panel.

Liz: grafana login OK, but mute button is greyed out (permission lacking).

Ravi: permissions again. Looks like multiple people only have viewer role. I'll escalate to infra-sre for role sync in the morning, but we need a mitigation tonight: Sam can handle muting.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT-BOT: active: #INC-2026 high latency in inference-hosting-us-west2. PagerDuty triggered 1778888001. Bridge: https://join.redwood/bridge/INC-2026

Ravi: seeing that alert. Per runbook, priority actions: 1) confirm customer impact, 2) route to degraded model if necessary, 3) open bridge and assign responder.

Liz: customer impact — monitoring shows increased 95p latency for hosted API only in us-west2, error rate steady. initial assessment: degraded latency, not 5xx flood.

Ash: i'm on logs. initial tail shows high token generation time on a subset of nodes. logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T21:02:12Z host-23 inference_time=1.23s token_latency=0.89s
2026-03-14T21:02:14Z host-27 inference_time=3.45s token_latency=3.10s
```
Suspect one GPU node on older runtime.

Ravi: Sam, can you check dedicated pool routing? if a pool is overloaded, route traffic to fallback pool per routing policy. guide: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/routing-fallback

Sam: doing. have access to router API. will flip to fallback pool for us-west2. command: 
```bash
redwoodctl routing set --region us-west2 --pool fallback-usw2 --reason "night handoff mitigation"
```
Will monitor impact.

Ravi: keep notes here. Also document any manual escalations you do in PD (incident notes).

Liz: done — added note in PD: "Investigating high token latency; routing change in progress"

Ash: infra-requests updated: IR-2047 includes request for assume-role perms for oncall set.

Ravi: coverage gap follow-up: Sam is covering PD/Grafana/AWS for 02:00-04:00 UTC. Thanks Sam. Ash will be available on pager for urgent follow-ups.

Sam: acknowledged. I'll be the escalation point. will update if i need more perms.

Ravi: final checks for handoff: - confirm you can access PD incidents and add notes - confirm AWS assume-role or have Sam as backfill - confirm Grafana mute/unmute or Sam will do it - bookmark the runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/incident-playbook - bridge link posted by bot.

Liz: all set from my side except PD escalate and grafana mute; Sam covering both.

Ash: ping me on pager if anything spikes.

Ravi: thanks all. i'll post completion in morning. :white_check_mark:
